evals.prompt: [$slide maker] 我给你一个客户展厅方案 PPT。首页可以，目录页不像目录，而且 P1/P2 配图太像。请只重做目录页。
evals.expected_output: The agent should preserve the accepted cover, update style_spec/page_prompts for the rejected contents page, regenerate only slide 2, keep the visible title as 目录, and avoid reusing the cover hero scene or thumbnails.
assertions: Does not regenerate or overwrite the accepted slide 1 unless explicitly asked.
Keeps the contents page title as 目录 and uses clear chapter navigation.
Adds a forbidden pattern for reusing the cover hero visual before regenerating.
Produces or updates a contact sheet for visual comparison.

evals.prompt: [$slide maker] P2 可以，继续做后面几页，还是全图像化，文字多的做信息图。
evals.expected_output: The agent should continue from the existing image_manifest, generate only missing slides, inspect each generated candidate before capture, reject obvious repeated hero scenes, then build and validate an image-deck PPTX.
assertions: Starts from the existing manifest rather than restarting the deck.
Uses builtin-start, image_gen, and builtin-capture for each missing slide in membership mode.
Rejects generated slides that repeat the cover hero scene or add fake slogans/logos.
Runs validate_authoring, build_image_deck, validate_image_deck, and PPTX package integrity checks.

evals.prompt: [$slide maker] 这个正式汇报 PPT 要稳重高级，文字不要乱提炼，封面不要放 logo，除非是真 logo。
evals.expected_output: The agent should treat 'more premium' as stable formal report design, preserve source copy deliberately, avoid fake logos, and either use Image2-visible short source text or an explicit deterministic text fallback if exact visible copy is required.
assertions: Interprets premium as mature and formal, not trendy poster styling.
Does not invent a customer logo or brand mark.
Preserves source text in visible infographic elements or notes/source_map.
If exact visible text is required, records explicit non-Image2 fallback approval before deterministic text rendering.

evals.prompt: [$slide maker] 先做这个客户 PPT 前 3 页，企业色偏国网绿。要亮堂、有发布会和杂志风设计感，不要只是换色，版式和构图也要重新设计。
evals.expected_output: The agent should load the customer PPT polish SOP, create a sample-first workflow, define a brand/style lock, redesign each of the first three page roles with distinct composition, and produce a contact sheet for approval before continuing.
assertions: Loads references/customer_ppt_polish.md for customer PPT polish.
Creates a 3-page sample plan before full-deck generation.
States how each page composition changes, not only the palette.
Uses brand green as a disciplined system while keeping the deck bright and formal.
Produces a contact sheet or rendered preview for approval before continuing.

evals.prompt: [$slide maker] 我同事说文字不能你自己提炼，PPT 里面有的小字也要想办法保留。文字多的页面可以做成信息图或资讯图，但要看起来像 image-gen 设计过。
evals.expected_output: The agent should build a per-slide source copy map, keep source wording as the authority, turn dense body copy into visible infographic labels/cards/matrices where possible, and only move long details to notes/source_map with clear traceability.
assertions: Creates or describes a page-level copy map with source_title/source_body_copy/must_visible/can_visualize/notes_only.
Does not paraphrase or summarize customer copy unless explicitly asked.
Uses infographic forms such as information cards, matrices, tag rows, journey maps, or annotated scenes for dense slides.
Keeps exact long details in speaker notes/source_map when not visible.
Does not switch to local deterministic rendering unless exact text fidelity is explicitly approved.

evals.prompt: [$slide maker] 把我们这套客户 PPT 美化方法整理成别人也能照着做的交付流程。后续同事拿到一个正式客户稿，也要能做出同样质量。
evals.expected_output: The agent should route to customer_ppt_polish, document the sample-first workflow, source-copy policy, page-role grammar, lock/regenerate rules, QA evidence, and handoff checklist instead of only giving broad design advice.
assertions: References or updates a reusable SOP rather than only answering in chat.
Includes source-copy preservation, page-role grammar, and sample gating.
Defines lock approved pages and regenerate rejected pages as an operational rule.
Includes contact sheet, QA report, manifest, and package validation as delivery evidence.
Mentions image deck editability and Image2 Chinese text fidelity as risks.
